=== create src/controllers/pages/about.rs
//! `GET /about`: the about page. Generated by `cargo offrails generate page about`.

use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::views::{self, Ctx, pages::about::PagesAbout};

/// `GET /about`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn show(
    ctx: Ctx,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    // APP: a description for search results and link previews: ctx.described("…").
    Ok(views::render(PagesAbout {
        ctx: ctx.titled("About"),
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create src/views/pages/about.rs
//! The about page's struct. Generated by `cargo offrails generate page about`.

use askama::Template;

use crate::views::Ctx;
// The layout links with `paths::`.
use crate::routes::paths;

/// `GET /about`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "pages/about.html")]
pub struct PagesAbout {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
}

=== create templates/pages/about.html
{% extends "layouts/application.html" %}
{% import "components/ui.html" as ui %}
{% block content %}
{% call ui::page_header("About") %}{% endcall %}
<p>APP: the about page's words (templates/pages/about.html).</p>
{% endblock %}

=== create src/routes/about.rs
//! The about page (`cargo offrails generate page about`): its router, `paths::` helpers and `ROUTES` rows.
//! src/routes.rs wires it in with one `// about` line at `route mods`, `routes`, `paths`, `route tables`.

use axum::{Router, routing::get};

use super::{Access, Route};
use crate::state::AppState;

pub fn router() -> Router<AppState> {
    Router::new()
        .route("/about", get(crate::controllers::pages::about::show))
}

/// URL helpers; `crate::routes::paths` re-exports them.
pub mod paths {
    pub fn about() -> String {
        "/about".into()
    }
}

#[rustfmt::skip]
pub const ROUTES: &[Route] = &[
    ("GET",  "/about", "pages::about::show", Access::Public),
];

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: route mods
pub mod about; // about

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: routes
app = app.merge(about::router()); // about

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: paths
pub use super::about::paths::*; // about

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: route tables
// about
about::ROUTES,

=== wire src/controllers/meta.rs @ samples: sitemap paths
// about
paths::about(),

=== create tests/app/pages/about_test.rs
//! The about page. Generated by `cargo offrails generate page about`.

use offrails_app::routes::paths;

use crate::support::TestApp;

#[tokio::test]
async fn about_renders_publicly_and_is_in_the_sitemap() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::about())
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_contains("<title>About · ")
        .assert_text("About");
    app.get("/sitemap.xml")
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_contains(&format!("{}</loc>", paths::about()));
}
